name: Morning Shot Drinking Glasses | Set of 4 | 120 ml each | Upcycled from beer bottles
shortStory: Start your day with O.U.A.T.’s handcrafted Morning Shot Glasses, upcycled from rescued beer bottles collected across Goa. Perfect for wellness shots, fresh juices, detox waters and cold brews, these thoughtfully designed glasses bring a touch of conscious living to your daily rituals.
description: Start your day with O.U.A.T.’s handcrafted Morning Shot Glasses, upcycled from rescued beer bottles collected across Goa. Perfect for wellness shots, fresh juices, detox waters and cold brews, these thoughtfully designed glasses bring a touch of conscious living to your daily rituals.

note.title: A Note on Uniqueness
note.content:
Each glass is handcrafted from reclaimed amber beer bottles, so slight variations in shade, thickness, shape and finish are natural and make every piece unique.
Slight uneven patches may occasionally appear on the frosted surface due to moisture or handling. Gently wash with mild detergent and dry thoroughly with a soft cloth to restore an even finish.

sections.title: Product Features
sections.content:
• Material: Upcycled amber beer bottle glass
• Set Includes: 4 handcrafted shot glasses
• Capacity: 120 ml / 4 oz per glass
• Ideal for fresh juices, wellness drinks, cold brews, iced teas and water
• Reusable: Designed for everyday use
• Category: Glassware
• Net Weight: 1,300 g per set
• Dimensions: 40 × 12 × 12 cm (set dimensions)

sections.title: Care Instructions
sections.content:
• Handwash with mild dishwashing liquid to preserve the finish.
• The frosted base is created using an acid-free sandblasting technique. Do not use harsh abrasives, steel scrubbers, or strong chemicals while cleaning.
• Dry thoroughly with a soft cloth after washing.
• Suitable for cold and room-temperature beverages. Avoid hot beverages.
• Do not use if cracked or chipped.
